name: Local Models
description: Experimental Windows/NVIDIA local image, audio and 3D generation. Requires an unreleased native-job host extension; not compatible with stock Genex 0.1.7. One GPU worker at a time.

tools.name: inspect-use
tools.description: Required after integrating a generated asset. Observe the current game through the same host service as Genex Tools. Reports missing runtime loads, captures the actual frame, and verifies audible playback. A delivered file or loader stub is not integration.

tools.name: verify-use
tools.description: Record visible asset use after a successful current inspect-use. Use its exact inspectionId and describe what is visible in the attached frame. Cannot verify missing runtime loads.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Inspect assigned local generation models and readiness. No weights are loaded. Use before creating an asset.

tools.name: generate-image
tools.description: Generate a local PNG. Default assets, icons and model-reference purposes automatically receive Qwen native RGBA instructions and must pass a real alpha check. Agent supplies only its object description. Use purpose:scene for a full illustration or task:texture for an opaque material. One bounded native retry on alpha failure; no image editing or paid fallback.

purpose.description: Default asset: native transparent PNG. icon: readable icon. model-reference: isolated three-quarter object. scene: full image with a background. Do not set purpose for task:texture.

tools.name: generate-audio
tools.description: Generate sound effects or music with the assigned installed Stable Audio 3 Small Q8 model. One worker, unloaded after completion. No paid fallback.

tools.name: generate-model
tools.description: Generate a textured GLB with local Hunyuan3D. Use exactly one: prompt to save a Qwen reference and return nextCall (immediately follow it to finish Hunyuan3D in a separate tool call); imageJobId to reuse an existing image without copying paths; or image for a project image under assets/ or public/. GPU phases run sequentially. Reference is retained if mesh generation fails. No animation.

quality.description: Default balanced: 384 shape, 50k triangles, native 512px paint views, 1K atlas. Experimental high: 512 shape, up to 200k triangles, 512px views, 2K atlas; may introduce texture noise and takes longer. Both preserve surface normals. Higher density does not guarantee better appearance; inspect the result. No silent downgrade.

prompt.description: Describe the object and art style. The plugin automatically requests a native transparent three-quarter RGBA reference, then creates a textured GLB.

imageJobId.description: Exact completed image job UUID from this game; no manual copy or new image generation.

image.description: Exact project-relative PNG/JPEG/WebP path under assets/ or public/.

tools.name: retrieve
tools.description: Restore a retained job into the current game/build through normal Genex Assets delivery. Reuses saved bytes, never regenerates; refuses to overwrite changed files. Only jobs belonging to this game.

tools.name: assets
tools.description: List this game's retained Local Models assets and exact job IDs, including results from stopped builds. Read only: no models run and no files are copied. Use retrieve to restore a result into the current workspace.

skills.name: local-assets
skills.text: For a requested game build, art pass or gameplay improvement, first read theastraydev-local-models__skill {"name":"game-quality"}. Deliver a polished playable result by default: interpret the brief, strengthen its art direction and core feedback, integrate the requested assets, then inspect actual gameplay. Preserve the user's chosen style and scope; simple or low-poly does not mean unfinished. Treat VFX, shaders, 3D materials and performance as one visual result, not a pile of maximum settings. For a narrow repair apply this only to the affected experience; planning-only requests do not generate assets. When the user asks to build or improve a game, Local Models is their dedicated asset pipeline. During planning include suitable assets without generating. During implementation read theastraydev-local-models__skill {"name":"genex"} and {"name":"asset-preference"}, then check theastraydev-local-models__status and theastraydev-local-models__assets. Explicitly requested AI models, textures, music or sounds are acceptance requirements, not optional polish. In coordinated builds give one asset owner the exact requested categories, retained job IDs and integration responsibilities. Schedule required generation early alongside the playable foundation; do not defer all assets until a polished foundation. If changing owners, preserve completed files and transfer their job IDs; a stub or procedural fallback does not fulfill requested assets. Generate textured 3D with theastraydev-local-models__generate-model {name,prompt}. A prompt returns reference-ready, completed:false and nextCall: immediately follow nextCall to finish the authorized model request with imageJobId, without asking the user or regenerating the reference. A reference-only receipt is not a completed 3D asset. Separate tool calls keep each GPU phase inside Genex's deadline; no manual public-folder copy is required. Qwen generates images, Stable Audio music/SFX and Hunyuan3D meshes; Studio writes code. Use exact returned assets[].url, never reconstruct UUID paths. retrieve restores retained bytes into the current game/build and Genex Assets without inference. A generation receipt is not integration. Immediately wire the result into the real gameplay entity; never leave carModel:null, a car:null loader, or a procedural substitute after a requested model exists. The template loadAsset(name) only supports root slugs; use matching GLTFLoader.loadAsync with the exact returned URL for nested deliveries. After wiring call theastraydev-local-models__inspect-use {id:jobId}. Missing runtime loads must be fixed before claiming completion. Inspect its frame then theastraydev-local-models__verify-use with the current inspectionId and an honest visual note; audio requires advancing audible playback. In multi-worker builds assign required assets to a dedicated owner at the start with enough time for cold generation plus integration; a short foundation pass should not spend its whole budget generating assets for a later owner. Transfer the exact retained job IDs and let the receiving owner retrieve them. GPU jobs run sequentially and exit after each request. Respect explicit preferences and suitable existing assets. No silent paid fallback, downloads, assignment changes or publishing. Optional server features still use available official Genex tools and consent; this plugin is not a text/coding LLM or runtime inference server. For images the plugin automatically wraps your own object description in Qwen native RGBA instructions. Default purpose:asset and purpose:icon require real transparent PNG alpha; purpose:model-reference is set automatically for prompt-to-3D. Use purpose:scene only for a full illustration with background, and task:texture for opaque material tiles. Do not add a white/gray/checkerboard background to an isolated asset prompt or ask the user to remove it. Native alpha is checked without editing pixels; one failed alpha attempt gets one bounded retry, never an opaque substitute. Hunyuan defaults to quality:balanced (384 extraction, 50k triangles, native 512px paint views, 1K atlas). Experimental quality:high uses 512 extraction, up to 200k triangles and a 2K atlas, but can produce noisier textures; inspect the actual result instead of assuming more triangles look better. Use high only for an explicit higher-density or experimental request. Both preserve surface normals. Preserve quality in nextCall; never silently downgrade. Prompt-to-3D uses a 768px reference for high and 512px for balanced. Prioritize accurate construction, visible structural detail and soft neutral light in the reference while preserving the requested art style. Image-conditioned Hunyuan has no system prompt field; do not fake one or claim an absolute best-quality guarantee.

skills.name: asset-preference
skills.summary: Choose and integrate local generated assets during a requested game build, without needing a separate request for each model.

skills.name: cover
skills.summary: Choose a real gameplay cover for a game built with local assets, separately from generated UI art and the Studio sidebar image.

skills.name: creator-mcp
skills.summary: Coordinate Local Models with the bundled Genex creator MCP without confusing local generation, remote discovery and publishing.

skills.name: game-quality
skills.summary: Turn a Genex game brief into a distinctive, polished playable result; direct local asset models, 3D, VFX and shaders, then review actual gameplay before claiming quality.

skills.name: genex
skills.summary: Build a playable Genex game using local image, audio and mesh models automatically, from the brief through asset integration and verification.

skills.name: genex-cover
skills.summary: Stage and capture an honest 16 by 9 gameplay frame using Genex cover tools after integrating local assets.

skills.name: genex-llm-in-games
skills.summary: Route explicitly requested runtime NPC and quest inference through Genex's supported player approval flow instead of desktop asset generators.

skills.name: genex-monetization
skills.summary: Use locally generated item art alongside Genex's optional shop and purchase flow without treating the local plugin as a payment backend.

skills.name: genex-threejs-embed-auth
skills.summary: Keep player identity, saves and leaderboards on Genex when a locally generated game needs platform features.

skills.name: genex-threejs-multiplayer
skills.summary: Add optional Genex multiplayer while keeping locally generated meshes and sounds as static game assets.

skills.name: genex-tool-llm
skills.summary: Distinguish models used to build assets from an LLM requested inside the finished game, such as NPC dialogue or dynamic quests.

skills.name: genex-tool-publish
skills.summary: Check that local model outputs ship in a static export before using the official Genex draft or gallery publishing tools.

skills.name: genex-updates
skills.summary: Handle plugin, runtime and Genex compatibility updates without changing the user's game, assignments or installed model weights unnecessarily.

skills.name: publishing
skills.summary: Publish a locally generated game with Genex's existing hosting tools when the user asks for a draft or public release.

actions.name: install
actions.label: Install model
actions.confirmation: Download the selected public model and its verified runtime (up to 11 GB). Its original model license applies. No account or token is sent.

actions.name: restore-assets
actions.label: Restore generated assets to this game
